messages.subject: [R-sig-Fedora] Fedora 42 R source build issues
messages.body_plain:
Building R 4.5.0 from source on Fedora 42 hits problems because 42 ships with Tcl/Tk 9. tcl8-devel and tk8-devel are available and can be used, but I haven't yet found a viable incantation yet. Neither R released nor devel support Tcl/Tk 9 https://www.tcl-lang.com/software/tcltk/9.0.html.

Building against external BLAS is also not self-evident, so may need guidance.

Any suggestions welcome!

Roger

---
Roger Bivand
Emeritus Professor
Department of Economics
Norwegian School of Economics, Bergen, Norway

r-sig-fedora at r-project.org> wrote:

> Building R 4.5.0 from source on Fedora 42 hits problems because 42 ships
> with Tcl/Tk 9. tcl8-devel and tk8-devel are available and can be used, but
> I haven't yet found a viable incantation yet. Neither R released nor devel
> support Tcl/Tk 9 https://www.tcl-lang.com/software/tcltk/9.0.html.
>

Yes, you just need to install tcl8-devel and tk8-devel (and tell dnf to
remove version 9 if it's already there) and compile as usual.


> Building against external BLAS is also not self-evident, so may need
> guidance.


Building against FlexiBLAS is recommended. So you need to install
flexiblas-devel, then tell R via --with-blas=flexiblas --with-lapack.

See the configure part of our spec for a complete reference of what we do:

https://src.fedoraproject.org/rpms/R/blob/rawhide/f/R.spec#_326

I?aki

I have upgraded my fedora system to 42 (from 40) with R-4.5.0 but R-CoprManager seems to require a downgrading to R-4.4.3

Here is an excerpt of my attempt to update a few day later.

sudo dnf update --refresh
...
Problem 1: installed package R-CoprManager-0.5.7-1.fc42.copr8193539.noarch requires R(ABI) = 4.4, but none of the 
providers can be installed
    - R-core-4.4.3-1.fc42.i686 from fedora has inferior architecture
   - cannot install both R-core-4.5.0-3.fc42.x86_64 from updates and R-core-4.5.0-3.fc42~bootstrap.x86_64 from @System
   - cannot install both R-core-4.5.0-3.fc42.x86_64 from updates and R-core-4.4.3-1.fc42.x86_64 from fedora

R-core-4.5.0-3.fc42.x86_64 from updates
   - cannot install the best update candidate for package R-core-4.5.0-3.fc42~bootstrap.x86_64
   - cannot install the best update candidate for package R-CoprManager-0.5.7-1.fc42.copr8193539.noarch
  Problem 2: problem with installed package
   - installed package R-CoprManager-0.5.7-1.fc42.copr8193539.noarch requires R(ABI) = 4.4, but none of the providers 
can be installed

....

Am I the only one to have this problem?
